//! Release activation extends the existing engine transaction and generation.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#5-hot-activation-and-ownership — CAS includes every activation, not only semantic changes.
use super::*;
use rusqlite::OptionalExtension;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ReleaseActivation {
    pub release: u64,
    pub expected_previous: Option<u64>,
    pub expected_revision: Option<u64>,
    pub restore_dormant: bool,
    pub native_digest: Option<String>,
    pub operation: String,
}
impl ReleaseActivation {
    pub fn new(release: u64, expected_previous: Option<u64>) -> Self {
        Self {
            release,
            expected_previous,
            expected_revision: None,
            restore_dormant: true,
            native_digest: None,
            operation: "activate".into(),
        }
    }
    pub(crate) fn check(&self, conn: &rusqlite::Connection) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let actual: Option<String> = conn
            .query_row("SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key='release'", [], |r| {
                r.get(0)
            })
            .optional()?;
        if actual
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|s| s.parse::<u64>().ok() != self.expected_previous)
        {
            return Err(RuntimeError::Generation("current release changed; run `snapback4 releases <dir>` and retry the selected release".into()));
        }
        let revision: Option<String> = conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key='release_revision'",
                [],
                |r| r.get(0),
            )
            .optional()?;
        let revision = revision.and_then(|v| v.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        if self.expected_revision.is_some_and(|n| n != revision) {
            return Err(RuntimeError::Generation("activation revision changed (including rollback/equal-content activation); run `snapback4 releases <dir>` and retry".into()));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Engine {
    pub fn new_release(
        store: Store,
        schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        release: u64,
        expected_previous: Option<u64>,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        Self::new_release_with_feed_adoption(
            store,
            schema,
            programs,
            release,
            expected_previous,
            false,
        )
    }
    pub fn new_release_with_feed_adoption(
        store: Store,
        schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        release: u64,
        expected_previous: Option<u64>,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        Self::new_release_prepared(
            store,
            schema,
            programs,
            &ReleaseActivation::new(release, expected_previous),
            allow_feed_adoption,
        )
    }
    pub fn new_release_prepared(
        store: Store, schema: Schema, programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation, allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        Self::new_release_prepared_at(store,schema,programs,options,allow_feed_adoption,crate::now_ms())
    }
    pub fn new_release_prepared_at(
        mut store: Store,
        mut schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        prepare(&mut schema)?;
        let programs = programs.into_iter().map(|p| (p.name.clone(), p)).collect();
        let (generation, metadata) = Self::activate(
            &mut store,
            &schema,
            &programs,
            Some(options),
            now,
            allow_feed_adoption,
            None,
            None,
        )?;
        store.exclude_ephemeral(&schema);
        Ok(Self {
            timeline_schedule: timeline::Schedule::default(),
            ephemeral: std::sync::Arc::new(ephemeral::Hub::new(
                metadata.store_id,
                generation,
                &schema,
            )),
            store,
            schema,
            programs,
            generation,
            expiry_after: BTreeMap::new(),
            dev_effects: false,
            ceilings: Ceilings::default(),
            entropy: crate::ids::seed(),
            minter: crate::ids::Mint::default(),
            #[cfg(feature = "native")]
            native: None,
            #[cfg(feature = "native")]
            native_logs: native::Logs::default(),
            presence: None,
        })
    }
    /// No replacement engine, post-commit SQL read, or fallible ephemeral swap.
    pub fn adopt_release(
        &mut self, schema: Schema, programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation, allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    ) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
        self.adopt_release_at(schema,programs,options,allow_feed_adoption,crate::now_ms())
    }
    pub fn adopt_release_at(
        &mut self,
        mut schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
        prepare(&mut schema)?;
        let programs = programs.into_iter().map(|p| (p.name.clone(), p)).collect();
        drop(self.ephemeral.lock()?);
        let (generation, metadata) = Self::activate(
            &mut self.store,
            &schema,
            &programs,
            Some(options),
            now,
            allow_feed_adoption,
            None,
            None,
        )?;
        self.store.exclude_ephemeral(&schema);
        self.timeline_schedule = timeline::Schedule::default();
        self.schema = schema;
        self.programs = programs;
        self.generation = generation;
        self.expiry_after.clear();
        self.dev_effects = false;
        self.ephemeral
            .rebind_committed(metadata.store_id, generation, &self.schema);
        Ok(generation)
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "native")]
    pub fn set_prepared_native(&mut self, module: Option<std::sync::Arc<native::Module>>) {
        self.native = module;
    }
}

fn prepare(schema: &mut Schema) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    columns::validate_before_prepare(schema)?;
    schema.check_row_view_audiences()?;
    schema.prepare_contribution_indexes();
    schema.prepare_delivery_lookup();
    if let Some(issue) = crate::schema::validate(schema).first() {
        return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
            "{}: {}",
            issue.path, issue.message
        )));
    }
    Ok(())
}
//! Server activation builder; all fallible work precedes commit.
use super::*;
impl Engine {
    pub(super) fn activate(
        store: &mut Store,
        schema: &Schema,
        programs: &BTreeMap<String, Program>,
        release: Option<&release::ReleaseActivation>,
        now: i64,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
        expected_release: Option<u64>,
        expected_backend: Option<&crate::store::opening::Backend>,
    ) -> Result<(u64, crate::store::opening::Metadata), RuntimeError> {
        schema.validate_column_owners()?;
        for program in programs.values() {
            crate::schema::ephemeral::admit_program(schema, program)?;
            admission::check_state_predicates(schema, program)?;
        }
        for program in programs.values() {
            for table in crate::ir::read_sites(program)
                .into_iter()
                .map(|s| s.table)
                .chain(crate::ir::write_tables(program).into_iter().map(|(t, _)| t))
            {
                schema.refuse_private(&table)?;
            }
        }
        for schedule in &schema.schedules {
            if !schedule.valid()
            {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
                    "schedule {} has an invalid period or offset",
                    schedule.name
                )));
            }
            let Some(program) = programs
                .get(&schedule.target)
                .filter(|p| matches!(p.kind, ProgramKind::Job | ProgramKind::Action))
            else {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
                    "schedule {} names missing job or action {}; restore or remove the schedule",
                    schedule.name, schedule.target
                )));
            };
            if program.kind == ProgramKind::Action {
                let seat = schedule
                    .service
                    .as_deref()
                    .filter(|seat| crate::identity::is_service(seat))
                    .ok_or_else(|| {
                        RuntimeError::Schema(
                            "a scheduled action requires its declared service seat".into(),
                        )
                    })?;
                actions::authorize(program, seat)?;
            } else if schedule.service.is_some() {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(
                    "a scheduled job cannot name a service seat".into(),
                ));
            }
            if program.args.iter().any(|(name, kind)| {
                !matches!(name.as_str(), "periodStart" | "periodEnd")
                    || *kind != crate::ir::ArgType::Time
            }) {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(
                    "scheduled work takes periodStart: time and periodEnd: time, or nothing".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        let prior_items = std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new());
        let population=std::cell::Cell::new(None);
        let outcome=store.activate_at_with_launch(schema, Some(programs), false, now, allow_feed_adoption, |conn| {
            Store::check_selected_release(conn, expected_release)?;
            if let Some(backend) = expected_backend { backend.check(conn)?; }
            if let Some(options)=release {
                options.check(conn)?;
                *prior_items.borrow_mut()=crate::store::release_history::inventory(conn,None,usize::MAX)?;
                crate::store::dormant::enable(conn)?;
                conn.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key,value) VALUES('release_native_digest',?1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value",[options.native_digest.as_deref().unwrap_or("")])?;
                conn.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key,value) VALUES('activation_restore',?1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value",[if options.restore_dormant {"true"}else{"false"}])?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }, |tx, changed, report| {
            let now=now.max(tx.time_audience_clock()?);
            if let Some(options)=release {tx.set_meta("release",&options.release.to_string())?;}
            use rusqlite::OptionalExtension;
            let repair_live_sums = tx.conn().query_row("SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key = 'live_sum_candidates'", [], |row| row.get::<_, String>(0)).optional()?.as_deref() != Some("1");
            let previous: Option<String> = tx.conn().query_row("SELECT schema FROM _generations WHERE generation = (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM _meta WHERE key = 'generation')", [], |row| row.get(0)).optional()?;
            let previous: Option<Schema> = previous.map(|text| serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|e| RuntimeError::decode(e, RuntimeError::Store))).transpose()?;
            let needs_maintained_id_marker = (schema.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none())
                || previous.as_ref().is_some_and(|old| old.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none())))
                && tx.meta(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META)?.as_deref() != Some(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_VERSION);
            if !changed && !repair_live_sums && !needs_maintained_id_marker { return Ok(()); }
            let repair_maintained_ids = needs_maintained_id_marker
                && previous.as_ref().is_some_and(|old| old.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none()));
            if changed {
                let epoch = tx.next_seq()?;
                for table in partition::changed_group_audiences(previous.as_ref(), schema) {
                    tx.set_meta(&partition::audience_epoch_key(&table), &epoch.to_string())?;
                    tx.set_meta(&partition::audience_epoch_time_key(&table), &now.to_string())?;
                }
            }
            let population_changed=tx.meta("activation_population")?.as_deref()==Some("true");
            let rebuild: Vec<_> = schema.maintains.iter().filter(|m| {
                (changed && (population_changed || previous.as_ref().is_none_or(|old| crate::successor::maintain_rebuild_needed(old, schema, m))))
                    || (repair_maintained_ids && m.row_key.is_none())
                    || (repair_live_sums && matches!(m.kind, crate::schema::MaintainKind::Sum { .. }) && schema.table(&m.source).is_some_and(|source| source.is_expiring()))
            }).collect();
            tx.set_meta("live_sum_candidates", "1")?;
            if needs_maintained_id_marker {
                // This write is inside the activation transaction: a failed
                // rebuild leaves both old rows and the old/missing marker. A
                // first aggregate has no legacy target identity to rewrite,
                // but records the current address function for later opens.
                tx.set_meta(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META, crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_VERSION)?;
            }
            let attribution = recorded::paths_changed(schema, previous.as_ref());
            let columns = column_activation::changed_parents(schema, if population_changed {None} else {previous.as_ref()});
            if rebuild.is_empty() && !attribution && columns.is_empty() && !repair_maintained_ids { return Ok(()); }
            let seq = tx.next_seq()?;
            let phase = std::time::Instant::now();
            if attribution {
                // This runner owns only activation rewrites; ordinary rebuilds
                // below retain their commit and partition accounting.
                let mut capture = Runner::new(tx, schema, Context::system().at(now), Meter::new(Ceilings::unbounded(), Cut::Abort), seq);
                capture.capture_activation(previous.as_ref(), Some(report))?;
                report.detail("capture recorded paths", phase);
                // A newly introduced aggregate has no legacy identity map to
                // preserve. Keep its event-free recorded-path rebuild out of
                // commit accounting, as activation did before the address
                // migration existed.
                if !repair_maintained_ids {
                    capture.rebuild_recorded_activation(previous.as_ref(), &rebuild.iter().copied().filter(|m| m.private.is_none()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), report)?;
                }
            }
            let mut runner = Runner::new(tx, schema, Context::system().at(now), Meter::new(Ceilings::unbounded(), Cut::Abort), seq);
            if repair_maintained_ids {
                let started = std::time::Instant::now();
                let rewritten = runner.rewrite_legacy_maintained_references(&rebuild.iter().copied().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(), previous.as_ref(), Some(tx))?;
                if rewritten != 0 { report.changes.push(format!("rewrote {rewritten} legacy aggregate references")); }
                report.detail("rewrite legacy aggregate references", started);
            }
            // Legacy maps must be captured before any activation rebuild can
            // remove their target rows. Recorded values themselves are
            // stamped first so their historical paths may still traverse the
            // predecessor addresses.
            if attribution && repair_maintained_ids {
                runner.rebuild_recorded_activation(previous.as_ref(), &rebuild.iter().copied().filter(|m| m.private.is_none()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), report)?;
            }
            runner.activate_columns(previous.as_ref(), &rebuild, &columns, Some(report))?;
            for maintain in rebuild.into_iter().filter(|m| m.private.is_none()) {
                if !recorded::table_paths_changed(schema.table(&maintain.source), previous.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.table(&maintain.source))) {
                    runner.rebuild_maintain_reported(maintain, report)?;
                }
            }
            let events = runner.events.take();
            let tables: Vec<String> = runner.written_tables.iter().cloned().collect();
            let written = runner.rows_written;
            drop(runner);
            if written > 0 || !columns.is_empty() {
                tx.record_commit(seq, now, "rebuild", crate::SYSTEM_PRINCIPAL, "rebuild", &tables, written)?;
                partition::append(tx, seq, &events)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }, |tx| {
            if let Some(options)=release {
                crate::store::release_history::finalize_restorations(tx)?;
                let mut items=crate::store::release_history::inventory(tx.conn(),None,usize::MAX)?;
                let dormant_items=items.len();
                let mut restored_items=0usize;
                for item in &mut items {
                    let before=prior_items.borrow().iter().find(|i|i.key==item.key).cloned();
                    let count=before.as_ref().map_or(0,|i|i.rows);
                    item.before_rows=Some(count);item.after_rows=Some(item.rows);
                    item.before_sample_ids=Some(before.map_or_else(Vec::new,|i|i.sample_ids));
                    let restored=if item.kind=="rows" {
                        tx.meta(&format!("activation_narrowed_restored:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)
                    } else if item.kind=="column" {tx.meta(&format!("activation_column_restored:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)} else {0};
                    item.restored_rows=Some(restored);
                    if restored>0 {item.action="partially restored".into();restored_items+=1;}
                }
                let remaining:std::collections::BTreeSet<_>=items.iter().map(|i|i.key.clone()).collect();
                for mut item in prior_items.borrow().iter().filter(|i|!remaining.contains(&i.key)).cloned() {
                    let restored=if matches!(item.kind.as_str(),"rows"|"column") {
                        let prefix=if item.kind=="rows" {"activation_narrowed_restored"} else {"activation_column_restored"};
                        tx.meta(&format!("{prefix}:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)
                    } else if item.kind=="table" {
                        tx.meta(&format!("activation_table_restored:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)
                    } else {item.rows};
                    item.action=if restored>0 || item.definition_only {"restored"} else {"removed without restoration"}.into();
                    item.before_rows=Some(item.rows);item.after_rows=Some(0);item.restored_rows=Some(restored);item.before_sample_ids=Some(item.sample_ids.clone());
                    if restored>0 || item.definition_only {restored_items+=1;}
                    items.push(item);
                }
                population.set(Some((tx.meta("activation_narrowed_retained")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0),tx.meta("activation_narrowed_restored")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0))));
                crate::store::release_history::event(tx,&options.operation,Some(options.release),options.expected_previous,serde_json::json!({"dormant_items":dormant_items,"restored_items":restored_items,"native_digest":options.native_digest,"narrowed_retained":tx.meta("activation_narrowed_retained")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0),"narrowed_restored":tx.meta("activation_narrowed_restored")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)}),&items)?;
                tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key IN ('activation_restore','activation_population','activation_narrowed_retained','activation_narrowed_restored') OR key LIKE 'activation_narrowed_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_column_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_table_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_table_restored_ids:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_narrowed_restored_ids:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_column_restored_ids:%'",[])?;
            }
            crate::store::opening::Metadata::read(tx)
        });
        if outcome.is_ok() {
            if let Some((retained,restored))=population.get().filter(|(a,b)|*a>0 || *b>0) {
                store.adoption_report.changes.insert(0,format!("{retained} newly dormant {}; {restored} narrowed {} restored", if retained == 1 { "row" } else { "rows" }, if restored == 1 { "row" } else { "rows" }));
            }
        }
        if outcome.is_ok() {
            if let Ok(items)=store.dormant_inventory(None,usize::MAX) {
                if release.is_some() { store.adoption_report.changes.insert(0, crate::store::adoption_report::AdoptionReport::dormant(&items)); }
            }
        }
        outcome
    }
}
//! A development reset: the adopted schema over an empty store, under a new
//! store identity, optionally reseeded, in one SQLite transaction.
// @ref LLP 3000.007#20.25 — what "fresh" keeps and what it empties; why the head keeps counting.
use super::*;

/// Tables a reset keeps whole: the store's own metadata, the catalog that
/// numbers tables and indexes, and the adopted generations.
const KEPT: [&str; 3] = ["_meta", "_catalog", "_generations"];

/// Identity tables a reset empties except for service seats: the dev
/// worker's session and `snapback4 token` seats outlive a reset, accounts,
/// guests and their sessions do not.
const SERVICE_SEATS: [(&str, &str); 5] = [
    ("_principals", "id"), ("_sessions", "principal"), ("_read_sessions", "principal"),
    ("_principal_generations", "principal"), ("_session_mint_bindings", "principal"),
];

/// What a development reset did. The caller unlinks `assets` after the
/// commit, outside any engine guard it holds.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct DevReset {
    pub previous_store_id: String,
    pub store_id: String,
    /// The store's head after the reset and any reseed.
    pub seq: u64,
    pub seeded: u64,
    pub assets: assets::AssetSweep,
}

impl Engine {
    /// Empty every application table and everything derived from them
    /// (views, maintained columns, indexes, counts, the partition log),
    /// every queue (effects, jobs, actions), uploaded assets and every
    /// non-service account and session; keep the adopted schema and
    /// generation. The store takes a new identity so a connected device
    /// re-acquires instead of keeping its partition; the head keeps counting
    /// (the reset is itself a commit). `rows` are then written as `/seed`
    /// writes them, in the same transaction. Development only: the release
    /// host never calls this.
    pub fn dev_reset_at(&mut self, rows: Vec<(String, Value)>, now: i64) -> Result<DevReset, RuntimeError> {
        // Like adoption: no ephemeral program runs across the identity change.
        drop(self.ephemeral.lock()?);
        let tx = self.store.transaction()?;
        // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.000.000#2-fixture-semantics — the new store identity must not inherit the retired store's future clock.
        tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key = 'time_audience_clock'", [])?;
        let now = time_audience::pin_writer_time(&self.schema, &tx, now)?;
        let previous_store_id = tx.meta("store_id")?.unwrap_or_default();
        let head = tx.next_seq()?.saturating_sub(1);
        let assets: Vec<String> = tx.conn().prepare("SELECT id FROM _assets")?.query_map([], |row| row.get(0))?.collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;
        let tables: Vec<String> = tx.conn()
            .prepare("SELECT name FROM main.sqlite_schema WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite\\_%' ESCAPE '\\'")?
            .query_map([], |row| row.get(0))?.collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;
        // @ref LLP 3000.039#6.5 — every table empties together: no referential action runs, and no reference is left naming a removed row.
        for table in &tables {
            if KEPT.contains(&table.as_str()) { continue; }
            let quoted = format!("\"{}\"", table.replace('"', "\"\""));
            match SERVICE_SEATS.iter().find(|(name, _)| name == table) {
                Some((_, column)) => tx.conn().execute(&format!("DELETE FROM {quoted} WHERE substr({column}, 1, ?2) <> ?1"),
                    rusqlite::params![crate::identity::SERVICE_PREFIX, crate::identity::SERVICE_PREFIX.len() as i64])?,
                None => tx.conn().execute(&format!("DELETE FROM {quoted}"), [])?,
            };
        }
        // Prime at the reset clock in this transaction: no old period fires,
        // and the next crossed boundary fires normally. Replay's count restarts.
        tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key LIKE 'schedule:%' OR key LIKE 'schedule-shape:%' OR key = 'dev:suppressed-effects'", [])?;
        for schedule in &self.schema.schedules {
            tx.set_meta(&format!("schedule:{}", schedule.name), &schedule.boundary(now).to_string())?;
            tx.set_meta(&format!("schedule-shape:{}", schedule.name), &crate::value::digest(schedule))?;
        }
        tx.conn().execute("UPDATE _meta SET value = lower(hex(randomblob(16))) WHERE key = 'store_id'", [])?;
        let store_id = tx.meta("store_id")?.unwrap_or_default();
        // Every table changed: no change evidence may certify an interval
        // across the reset.
        tx.changes.borrow_mut().widen();
        let touched: Vec<String> = self.schema.visible_tables().map(|(name, _)| name.clone()).collect();
        tx.record_commit(head + 1, now, "dev reset", crate::SYSTEM_PRINCIPAL, "reset", &touched, 0)?;
        if crate::store::backfills::has_evidence(&tx)? {crate::store::backfills::prepare_inputs(&tx,&self.schema,None)?;}
        let seeded = seed_rows(&self.schema, &tx, rows, now)?;
        let seq = tx.next_seq()?.saturating_sub(1);
        tx.commit()?;
        // A new store identity starts a fresh bounded expiry walk. Clear only
        // after commit so a refused reset keeps the old store's continuation.
        self.expiry_after.clear();
        self.timeline_schedule = timeline::Schedule::default();
        self.ephemeral.rebind_committed(store_id.clone(), self.generation, &self.schema);
        Ok(DevReset { previous_store_id, store_id, seq, seeded, assets: assets::AssetSweep::named(assets, self.store.assets_dir()) })
    }
}
//! Bind historical arguments without requiring them in the current row type.
use super::*;
use crate::{ast, diag::{type_error, unknown}, types::{Ty, scalar_to_column}};
use snapback4_core::schema::backfill::Backfill;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
pub(super) fn bind(catalog: &Catalog, schema: &mut Schema, diagnostics: &mut Vec<Diagnostic>) {
    let mut names = BTreeSet::new(); let mut outputs = BTreeSet::new();
    for d in catalog.documents.iter().flat_map(|d| &d.backfills) {
        if !names.insert((d.table.clone(),d.name.clone())) { diagnostics.push(unknown(&d.site,"duplicate backfill name on this table","give each historical transform its own name")); continue; }
        let decl = ast::ProgramDecl { delivery: None, held:false, predicts:false, server:false, kind:ast::ProgramKind::Query,
            name: format!("backfill{}{}",d.table,d.name), args:d.args.clone(), prelude:vec![],
            body:vec![ast::Stmt::Return { value:d.value.clone(), site:d.site.clone() }], native:false, site:d.site.clone() };
        let Some(bound) = program::Binder::bind(catalog,schema,"schema",&decl,diagnostics) else {continue};
        let Ty::Object(fields) = &bound.result else { diagnostics.push(type_error(&d.site,"backfill returns an object patch","{ column: historicalValue }")); continue; };
        let Some(table) = schema.table(&d.table) else {diagnostics.push(unknown(&d.site,"backfill table is not declared","declare the candidate table"));continue};
        for (c,ty) in fields {
            if let Some(kind) = table.columns.get(c) {
                if !ty.assignable_to(&Ty::from_column(kind)) { diagnostics.push(type_error(&d.site,format!("backfill {}.{c} returns {}, expected {}",d.table,ty.name(),kind),"return a value fitting the candidate column")); }
            }
            if !outputs.insert((d.table.clone(),c.clone())) { diagnostics.push(type_error(&d.site,format!("backfills overlap on {}.{c}",d.table),"combine simultaneous outputs in one backfill")); }
        }
        let fill = Backfill { table:d.table.clone(), name:d.name.clone(), inputs:d.args.iter().map(|a|(a.name.clone(),scalar_to_column(&a.type_))).collect::<BTreeMap<_,_>>(), outputs:fields.keys().cloned().collect(), program:bound.program };
        if let Err(why) = fill.admit(schema) { diagnostics.push(type_error(&d.site,why,"use deterministic historical fields and a scalar patch").guide("deploy")); }
        schema.backfills.push(fill.normalized());
    }
}

codex
The implementation stages patches in SQLite and uses per-lifetime receipts to reconstruct re-entry snapshots. I’m checking how those receipts interact with retained reference bindings and multiple adoption cohorts, where the security and snapshot guarantees are most sensitive.

//! Release row lifetimes whose present values cannot inhabit the selected type.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#91-per-row-narrowed-value-dormancy — hide a reference-closed population; never coerce values.
use super::*;
use crate::schema::{ColumnType, Constraint};

pub(super) fn present(conn: &Connection) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    Ok(conn.query_row(
        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='_dormant_narrow_rows')",
        [],
        |r| r.get(0),
    )?)
}

fn incompatible(tx:&Tx<'_>,schema: &Schema, name: &str, row: &Value) -> Result<bool,RuntimeError> {
    incompatible_except(tx,schema,name,row,&[])
}
fn incompatible_except(tx:&Tx<'_>,schema: &Schema,name:&str,row:&Value,authority:&[String])->Result<bool,RuntimeError> {
    let table = &schema.tables[name];
    for (column,kind) in &table.columns {
        if table.engine_field(column) || table.maintained.contains_key(column) || authority.contains(column) {continue;}
        if let Ok(value)=row.field(column) {
            if incompatible_column(tx, table, name, column, kind, value)? { return Ok(true); }
        }
    }
    Ok(false)
}

// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#11-wave-11-factual-release-narration — the warning and activation share the value predicate, including ledger-backed assets.
pub(super) fn incompatible_column(tx: &Tx<'_>, table: &Table, name: &str, column: &str, kind: &ColumnType, value: &Value) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    if crate::engine::validate::validate_column(name, column, kind, Some(value)).is_err() { return Ok(true); }
    // @ref LLP 3000.038#1-the-type — asset facts belong to the ledger, including optional/list leaves.
    match super::activation::validate_assets(tx, kind, Some(value)) {
        Err(RuntimeError::Asset { code: "E_ASSET_TYPE" | "E_ASSET_TOO_LARGE", .. }) => return Ok(true),
        Err(error) => return Err(error),
        Ok(()) => (),
    }
    Ok(table.constraints.iter().any(|c| matches!(c, Constraint::Text { field, min, format }
        if field == column && matches!(value, Value::String(s)
            if crate::engine::validate::validate_text(field, s, *min, *format).is_err()))))
}

fn refs(kind: &ColumnType, value: &Value, out: &mut Vec<(String, String)>) {
    match (kind, value) {
        (ColumnType::Optional(inner), v) => refs(inner, v, out),
        (ColumnType::List { of, .. } | ColumnType::ListRange { of, .. }, Value::Array(vs)) => {
            for v in vs {
                refs(of, v, out);
            }
        }
        (ColumnType::Ref { table }, Value::Id(id)) => out.push((table.clone(), id.clone())),
        _ => {}
    }
}

pub(super) fn transition(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    next: &Schema,
    previous: Option<&Schema>,
    now: i64,
    restored_images: bool,
    source_definitions: &BTreeMap<String, Table>,
    authority_sources: &BTreeMap<String, Table>,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    retire_sources(tx,next,previous,now)?;
    let have_dormant: bool = tx.conn().query_row(
        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows)",
        [],
        |r| r.get(0),
    )?;
    let type_change = previous.is_some_and(|old| {
        next.tables.iter().any(|(name, t)| {
            old.table(name).is_some_and(|p| {
                t.columns
                    .iter()
                    .any(|(c, k)| p.columns.get(c).is_some_and(|old| old != k))
                    || t.constraints
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|c| matches!(c, Constraint::Text { .. }))
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                        != p.constraints
                            .iter()
                            .filter(|c| matches!(c, Constraint::Text { .. }))
                            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            })
        })
    });
    if !have_dormant && !type_change && !restored_images {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let mut newly_retained = 0u64;
    // Stream on the primary key. Do not retain a store-sized list of images.
    restore_images(tx,next,now,source_definitions,authority_sources,false)?;
    tx.clear_activation_scan();
    // References to a hidden row hide their dependents, including memberships.
    loop {
        let mut removed = 0u64;
        for (name, table) in next
            .tables
            .iter()
            .filter(|(n, t)| t.ephemeral.is_none() && next.maintain_for(n).is_none())
        {
            let t = tx.num(name)?;
            super::activation::walk(tx, t, |id, mut row| {
                if let Some(source)=authority_sources.get(name) {
                    if crate::engine::through_activation::Retirement::retires_image(table,source,&row,now) {
                        tx.delete(name,source,&row)?;
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                }
                crate::schema::materialize_optional_fields(
                    &mut row,
                    previous.and_then(|s| s.table(name)).unwrap_or(table),
                );
                let mut hidden = incompatible(tx,next, name, &row)?;
                for (column, kind) in &table.columns {
                    let mut edges = Vec::new();
                    if let Ok(value) = row.field(column) {
                        refs(kind, value, &mut edges);
                    }
                    for (parent, parent_id) in edges {
                        let missing = next.table(&parent).is_none()
                            || (!tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",params![tx.num(&parent)?,parent_id],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))?
                                && reserved(tx, tx.num(&parent)?, &parent_id)?);
                        if missing {
                            hidden = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if !hidden {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                let retained: bool = tx.conn().query_row(
                    "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",
                    params![t, id],
                    |r| r.get(0),
                )?;
                let outputs:std::collections::BTreeSet<_>=next.backfills.iter().filter(|f|f.table==*name).flat_map(|f|f.outputs.iter().cloned()).collect();
                if retained && !outputs.is_empty() {
                    // Preserve the original source/provenance, updating only
                    // authoritative cells this release explicitly transformed.
                    let data:String=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id],|r|r.get(0))?;
                    let mut archived:Value=serde_json::from_str(&data).map_err(|e|RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?;
                    if let Value::Row(fields)|Value::Map(fields)=&mut archived {for c in &outputs {if let Ok(v)=row.field(c){fields.insert(c.clone(),v.clone());}}}
                    tx.conn().execute("UPDATE _dormant_narrow_rows SET data=?1 WHERE t=?2 AND id=?3",params![canonical_json(&archived),t,id])?;
                }
                for c in &outputs {
                    // Candidate-typed new references are absent from the old
                    // definition. Never erase an already-invalid binding.
                    let invalid:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3 AND invalid=1)",params![t,id,c],|r|r.get(0))?;
                    if !invalid {if let Ok(value)=row.field(c) {super::dormant::capture_refs(tx,t,id,c,&table.columns[c],value)?;}}
                }
                if !retained {
                    newly_retained += 1;
                    let old = authority_sources.get(name).unwrap_or(table);
                    tx.conn().execute(
                        "INSERT INTO _dormant_narrow_rows VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5)",
                        params![
                            t,
                            id,
                            canonical_json(&row),
                            canonical_json(old),
                            "type or dormant reference"
                        ],
                    )?;
                    for (column, kind) in &old.columns {
                        // Retained cells/whole rows already captured a lifetime; moving them must not erase deletion evidence.
                        let captured:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3)",params![t,id,column],|r|r.get(0))?;
                        if captured {
                            continue;
                        }
                        if let Ok(value) = row.field(column) {
                            if !super::authority_origin::live_input(old,column) {super::dormant::capture_refs(tx, t, id, column, kind, value)?;}
                        }
                        super::dormant::capture_through_parent(tx, name, old, id, column, &row)?;
                        // Nominal keep references may already be dangling. They have no bound lifetime.
                    }
                }
                tx.conn()
                    .execute("DELETE FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2", params![t, id])?;
                removed += 1;
                Ok(())
            })?;
            tx.clear_activation_scan();
        }
        if removed == 0 {
            break;
        }
    }
    // Consume only rows that survived the closed population, not hidden dependents.
    let restored:u64=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _dormant_narrow_rows n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=n.t AND r.id=n.id)",[],|r|r.get::<_,i64>(0).map(|n|n as u64))?;
    if super::live_activation::active(tx)? {
        tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO temp._live_restored SELECT 'narrowed',n.t,'',n.id FROM _dormant_narrow_rows n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=n.t AND r.id=n.id)",[])?;
    } else {
    let restored_rows=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT c.name,n.id FROM _dormant_narrow_rows n JOIN _catalog c ON c.num=n.t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=n.t AND r.id=n.id)")?.query_map([],|r|Ok((r.get::<_,String>(0)?,r.get::<_,String>(1)?)))?.collect::<Result<Vec<_>,_>>()?;
    let mut restored_tables:std::collections::BTreeMap<String,Vec<String>>=std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
    for (name,id) in restored_rows {restored_tables.entry(name).or_default().push(id);}
    for (name, ids) in restored_tables {
        tx.set_meta(&format!("activation_narrowed_restored:{name}"),&ids.len().to_string())?;
        tx.set_meta(&format!("activation_narrowed_restored_ids:{name}"),&serde_json::to_string(&ids).map_err(|e|RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?)?;
    }
    }
    tx.set_meta("activation_narrowed_retained", &newly_retained.to_string())?;
    tx.set_meta("activation_narrowed_restored", &restored.to_string())?;
    tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_dormant_narrow_rows.t AND r.id=_dormant_narrow_rows.id)",[])?;
    if newly_retained > 0 || restored > 0 {
        tx.set_meta("activation_population", "true")?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn reserved(tx: &Tx<'_>, t: i64, id: &str) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    if !present(tx.conn())? {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    Ok(tx.conn().query_row(
        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",
        params![t, id],
        |r| r.get(0),
    )?)
}

pub(super) fn check_write(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    name: &str,
    _table: &Table,
    row: &Value,
    old: Option<&Value>,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    if !present(tx.conn())? {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let id = row.field("id")?.as_str()?;
    let conflict = old.is_none() && reserved(tx, tx.num(name)?, id)?;
    if conflict {
        return Err(RuntimeError::Rule {
            table: name.into(),
            effect: if old.is_some() {
                crate::schema::Effect::Update
            } else {
                crate::schema::Effect::Insert
            },
        });
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn retire_sources(tx:&Tx<'_>,next:&Schema,previous:Option<&Schema>,now:i64)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    let backfilling=!next.backfills.is_empty() || super::backfills::has_evidence(tx)?;
    // An expired predecessor must not be archived and later revived without its lifetime.
    if let Some(previous) = previous {
        let retirement = crate::engine::through_activation::Retirement::new(next, previous, now);
        for (name, old) in &previous.tables {
            if next.tables.contains_key(name) && (retirement.affects(name) || backfilling) {
                super::activation::walk(tx, tx.num(name)?, |_, row| {
                    if retirement.retires(name, &row) || backfilling && old.expired(&row,now) {
                        tx.delete(name, old, &row)?;
                    }
                    Ok(())
                })?;
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

// Restore retained source images before backfill evaluation. Candidate-owned
// output cells are checked after transformation, so a same-column enum rename
// does not preclude its own source image from entering the snapshot.
pub(super) fn restore_images(tx:&Tx<'_>,next:&Schema,now:i64,source_definitions:&BTreeMap<String,Table>,authority_sources:&BTreeMap<String,Table>,for_backfills:bool)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    let rewritten=if for_backfills {super::backfills::columns(tx,next)?}else{Default::default()};
    let mut cursor = (0i64, String::new());
    loop {
        let item: Option<(i64,String,i64,i64)> = tx.conn().query_row(
            "SELECT t,id,octet_length(data),octet_length(definition) FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE (t,id)>(?1,?2) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_dormant_narrow_rows.t AND r.id=_dormant_narrow_rows.id) ORDER BY t,id LIMIT 1",
            params![cursor.0,cursor.1],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?,r.get(2)?,r.get(3)?))).optional()?;
        let Some((t,id,data_bytes,definition_bytes))=item else {break};
        // Retain one admitted provenance/image unit through decode, overlays,
        // reconciliation and encoding. Never own its blobs before this bound.
        let mut admission=crate::meter::Meter::new(crate::meter::Ceilings::job(),crate::meter::Cut::Abort);
        if super::live_activation::active(tx)? {
            admission.heap((data_bytes as u64).saturating_add(definition_bytes as u64).saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(8192))?;
        }
        let (data,definition):(String,String)=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data,definition FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?)))?;
        cursor = (t, id.clone());
        let name: String =
            tx.conn()
                .query_row("SELECT name FROM _catalog WHERE num=?1", [t], |r| r.get(0))?;
        let Some(table) = next
            .table(&name)
            .filter(|t| t.ephemeral.is_none() && next.maintain_for(&name).is_none())
        else {
            continue;
        };
        let old: Table =
            serde_json::from_str(&definition).map_err(|e| RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?;
        super::dormant::check_owner(tx, &name, &old, next)?;
        let mut row: Value =
            serde_json::from_str(&data).map_err(|e| RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?;
        super::backfills::record_omissions(tx,t,&id,&row)?;
        crate::schema::materialize_optional_fields(&mut row,&old);
        if for_backfills && old.expired(&row,now) {
            // Expose an expired source only inside the uncommitted lifecycle
            // phase so the ordinary engine can close its reference actions.
            tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO r(t,id,data) VALUES(?1,?2,?3)",params![t,id,canonical_json(&row)])?;
            continue;
        }
        let mut authority=crate::engine::through_activation::manual_authority_fields(next,&name,&old);
        if for_backfills { authority.extend(rewritten.get(&name).into_iter().flatten().cloned()); }
        if incompatible_except(tx,next,&name,&row,&authority)? {
            continue;
        }
        // Retained source deadlines precede projection, including removal of read-through itself.
        if crate::engine::through_activation::Retirement::retires_image(table,&old,&row,now)  {
            tx.delete(&name,&old,&row)?;
            continue;
        }
        // Actual deletion/reuse never recaptures a different parent lifetime.
        let invalid_columns = tx
            .conn()
            .prepare_cached(
                "SELECT column_name FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND invalid=1",
            )?
            .query_map(params![t, id], |r| r.get::<_, String>(0))?
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
        let mut invalid=false;
        for c in &invalid_columns {
            if for_backfills && next.backfills.iter().any(|f| f.table==name && f.inputs.contains_key(c)) {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Structural{code:"E_ADOPT",message:format!("backfill historical reference {name}.{c} on {id} lost its parent lifetime")});
            }
            if table.columns.contains_key(c) && !super::authority_origin::obsolete_ref(tx,t,&id,c,table,Some(&old))? {invalid=true;}
        }
        if invalid {
            continue;
        }
        if super::authority_origin::live_row(tx,t,&id,&old,table)? {
            admission.heap(crate::engine::through_activation::restored_parent_scratch(next,source_definitions,&name,&old).saturating_add(crate::rows::disclosed::decode_reservation(table).saturating_mul(4)))?;
        }
        super::authority_origin::record(tx,t,&id,&old)?;
        super::authority_origin::validate(tx,next,authority_sources,&name,&old,&row,now,true)?;
        crate::engine::through_activation::forward_image(tx,next,authority_sources,&name,&old,&row,now)?;
        if old.through.as_ref().is_some_and(|e|e.live.is_some()) {tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO temp._live_restored(kind,t,col,id) VALUES('live-authority',?1,'',?2)",params![t,id])?;}
        for column in old.columns.keys() {
            if !table.columns.contains_key(column) {
                super::dormant::definition(tx, &name, &old, column)?;
                if let Ok(value) = row.field(column) {
                    super::dormant::save_cell(tx, &name, &old, &id, column, value, false)?;
                }
            }
        }
        if !for_backfills { if let Value::Row(fields) | Value::Map(fields) = &mut row {
            fields.retain(|c, _| table.columns.contains_key(c));
        }}
        let values=super::dormant::restored_values(tx,t,&id,table,&mut admission)?;
        super::authority_origin::overlay(tx,t,&id,Some(&old),table,&mut row,values)?;
        if old.through.as_ref().is_none_or(|e|e.live.is_some()) {
            for column in table.columns.keys() {super::dormant::mark_live_column(tx,t,&id,column)?;}
        }
        crate::engine::through_activation::manual_image(tx,next,&name,&old,&mut row,now)?;
        if if for_backfills {incompatible_except(tx,next,&name,&row,&authority)?}else{incompatible(tx,next,&name,&row)?} {continue;}
        if !for_backfills {crate::schema::materialize_optional_fields(&mut row, table);}
        // Missing required new fields are a genuine backfill refusal, not dormancy.
        tx.conn().execute(
            "INSERT INTO r(t,id,data) VALUES(?1,?2,?3)",
            params![t, id, canonical_json(&row)],
        )?;
    }
    tx.clear_activation_scan();
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn capture_refs(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    t: i64,
    id: &str,
    column: &str,
    kind: &ColumnType,
    value: &Value,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    tx.conn().execute(
        "DELETE FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",
        params![t, id, column],
    )?;
    let mut refs = Vec::new();
    references(kind, value, &mut refs);
    for (parent, parent_id) in refs {
        add_reference(tx, t, id, column, &parent, &parent_id)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn add_reference(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    t: i64,
    id: &str,
    column: &str,
    parent: &str,
    parent_id: &str,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    let parent_t = tx.num(parent)?;
    let invalid = !tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",params![parent_t,parent_id],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))?
        && !tx.conn().query_row(
            "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",
            params![parent_t, parent_id],
            |r| r.get::<_, bool>(0),
        )?;
    tx.conn().execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _dormant_refs VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6)",
        params![t, id, column, parent_t, parent_id, if invalid {2} else {0}],
    )?;
    Ok(())
}
pub(super) fn capture_through_parent(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    name: &str,
    table: &Table,
    id: &str,
    column: &str,
    row: &Value,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    if let Some(through) = &table.through {
        if (through.fields.contains_key(column)
            || matches!(
                column,
                crate::schema::through::PARENT_DEADLINE | crate::schema::through::DEADLINE
            ))
            && let Ok(Value::Id(parent_id)) = row.field(&through.reference)
        {
            add_reference(tx, tx.num(name)?, id, column, &through.parent, parent_id)?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn save_cell(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    name: &str,
    table: &Table,
    id: &str,
    column: &str,
    value: &Value,
    capture: bool,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    let t = tx.num(name)?;
    // @ref LLP 3000.014.000#implementation-proof-clarifications — another row cannot overwrite a cell's live origin.
    let live=table.engine_field(column) && table.through.as_ref().is_some_and(|e|e.live.is_some());
    tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO _dormant_values(t,id,column_name,data,live_source) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5) ON CONFLICT(t,id,column_name) DO UPDATE SET data=excluded.data,live_source=excluded.live_source",params![t,id,column,canonical_json(value),i64::from(live)])?;
    if capture && !super::authority_origin::live_input(table,column) {
        capture_refs(tx, t, id, column, &table.columns[column], value)
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn check_references(tx: &Tx<'_>, next: &Schema,sources:&BTreeMap<String,Table>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    for (name, table) in next.tables.iter().filter(|(_, t)| t.ephemeral.is_none()) {
        let t = tx.num(name)?;
        let mut bad = super::adopt_refusals::Samples::default();
        let mut statement=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT DISTINCT d.id,d.column_name,d.parent_id,d.invalid FROM _dormant_refs d LEFT JOIN r p ON p.t=d.parent_t AND p.id=d.parent_id WHERE d.t=?1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r child WHERE child.t=d.t AND child.id=d.id) AND (d.invalid=1 OR (p.id IS NULL AND d.invalid!=2)) ORDER BY d.id,d.column_name")?;
        let mut rows = statement.query([t])?;
        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {
            let column: String = row.get(1)?;
            let id:String=row.get(0)?;
            if table.columns.contains_key(&column) && !super::authority_origin::obsolete_ref(tx,t,&id,&column,table,sources.get(name))? {
                bad.add(
                    &row.get::<_, String>(0)?,
                    &format!(
                        "{column} → parent {} (deleted/reused/missing)",
                        row.get::<_, String>(2)?
                    ),
                );
            }
        }
        if bad.count > 0 {
            return Err(refuse(format!(
                "table {name}: {}; dormant references cannot acquire another parent lifetime; keep the current release and repair the named references, or prune the dormant storage before restoring",
                bad.describe()
            )));
        }
        if let Some(through) = &table.through {
            {
                let mut bad = super::adopt_refusals::Samples::default();
                super::activation_walk::walk_metered(tx,t,crate::rows::adoption::Work::DECODE,None,|id,row,meter| {
                    let restored: bool = tx.conn().query_row(
                        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",
                        params![t, id],
                        |r| r.get(0),
                    )?;
                    if !restored {
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                    // The captured deadline belongs to one parent lifetime,
                    // even if an older schema allowed retargeting the active ref.
                    let parent_t = tx.num(&through.parent)?;
                    let current = row
                        .field(&through.reference)
                        .ok()
                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str().ok());
                    let mut evidence=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT parent_t,parent_id,(SELECT name FROM _catalog WHERE num=parent_t) FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3")?;
                    for edge in evidence.query_map(
                        params![t, id, crate::schema::through::PARENT_DEADLINE],
                        |r| {
                            Ok((
                                r.get::<_, i64>(0)?,
                                r.get::<_, String>(1)?,
                                r.get::<_, String>(2)?,
                            ))
                        },
                    )? {
                        let (old_table, old_id, old_name) = edge?;
                        if old_table != parent_t || current != Some(old_id.as_str()) {
                            bad.add(
                                id,
                                &format!(
                                    "{}.{}: recorded {} [{}], current {} [{}]",
                                    name,
                                    through.reference,
                                    old_name,
                                    old_id,
                                    through.parent,
                                    current.unwrap_or("<missing>")
                                ),
                            );
                            return Ok(());
                        }
                    }
                    if let Ok(Value::Id(parent_id)) = row.field(&through.reference) {
                        if through.live.is_some() || crate::rows::Rows::restored_live_authority(tx,name,id)? {
                            let bytes:Option<i64>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT octet_length(data) FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![parent_t,parent_id],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
                            meter.heap((bytes.unwrap_or(0) as u64).saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(4096))?;
                        }
                        if let Some(parent) = tx.get(&through.parent, parent_id)? {
                            let parent =
                                crate::schema::row_image(&parent, &next.tables[&through.parent]);
                            // @ref LLP 3000.014.000#71-dormant-restoration-identities-are-a-relation — live policy restamps current inputs after preserving parent lifetime.
                            if through.live.is_none() && !crate::rows::Rows::restored_live_authority(tx,name,id)? && through.fields.iter().any(|(capture, field)| {
                                row.field(capture)
                                    .ok()
                                    .is_some_and(|value| Some(value) != parent.field(field).ok())
                            }) {
                                bad.add(id,&format!("{}.{} parent {parent_id}: captured audience/identity changed",name,through.reference));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Ok(())
                })?;
                if bad.count > 0 {
                    return Err(refuse(format!(
                        "table {name}: {}; restore cannot rebind historical audience/deadline captures; restore the original parent reference and audience under the current release, then `snapback4 rollback <dir> --to N`, or explicitly `snapback4 prune <dir> --allow-destructive`",
                        bad.describe()
                    )));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn delete(tx: &Tx<'_>, t: i64, id: &str, name: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    super::backfills::delete(tx,t,id)?;
    if !enabled(tx)? {
        return Ok(());
    }
    tx.conn().execute(
        "UPDATE _dormant_refs SET invalid=1 WHERE parent_t=?1 AND parent_id=?2 AND invalid=0",
        params![t, id],
    )?;
    let narrowed=super::narrowed::present(tx.conn())?;
    let home=if narrowed {" OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?4 AND id=?2)"} else {""};
    tx.conn().execute(&format!("UPDATE _assets SET released_at=COALESCE(released_at,?3) WHERE home_table=?1 AND home_id=?2 AND (home_column IN (SELECT column_name FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?4 AND id=?2){home})"),params![name,id,crate::now_ms(),t])?;
    tx.conn().execute(
        "DELETE FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",
        params![t, id],
    )?;
    tx.conn().execute(
        "DELETE FROM _dormant_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",
        params![t, id],
    )?;
    if narrowed {tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id])?;}
    tx.conn().execute(
        "DELETE FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",
        params![t, id],
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn holds_home(tx: &Tx<'_>, table: &str, column: &str) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    if !enabled(tx)? {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    let narrowed=if super::narrowed::present(tx.conn())? {" OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows n JOIN _catalog c ON n.t=c.num WHERE c.name=?1)"}else{""};
    Ok(tx.conn().query_row(&format!("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_tables WHERE table_name=?1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_columns WHERE table_name=?1 AND column_name=?2){narrowed}"),params![table,column],|r|r.get(0))?)
}

/// Fetch only destination cells on live transitions, after paying their full
/// serialized/decoded coexistence in the owning activation page/row account.
pub(super) fn restored_values(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,table:&Table,meter:&mut crate::meter::Meter)->Result<Vec<(String,String)>,RuntimeError> {
    if !super::live_activation::active(tx)? {
        return Ok(tx.conn().prepare_cached("SELECT column_name,data FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2")?.query_map(params![t,id],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?)))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?);
    }
    let mut values=Vec::new();
    for column in table.columns.keys() {
        let bytes:Option<i64>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT octet_length(data) FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,column],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
        if let Some(bytes)=bytes {
            meter.heap((bytes as u64).saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(1024+column.len() as u64*8))?;
            let data:String=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,column],|r|r.get(0))?;
            values.push((column.clone(),data));
        }
    }
    Ok(values)
}

/// Narrowed forward correspondence has already run when this is called.
/// Record cell-derived live provenance before consuming any source evidence.
pub(super) fn mark_live_column(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,column:&str)->Result<(),RuntimeError> {
    if super::live_activation::active(tx)? && super::authority_origin::mode(tx,t,id)? != Some(1) {
        tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO temp._live_restored SELECT 'live-authority',?1,'',?2 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3 AND live_source=1)",params![t,id,column])?;
    }Ok(())
}

fn compile(source:&str)->(Schema,Vec<crate::ir::Program>){
    let b=snapback4_lang::compile(&[("schema.q".into(),source.into())]);
    assert!(b.diagnostics.is_empty(),"{:?}",b.diagnostics);
    (serde_json::from_str(&serde_json::to_string(&b.schema).unwrap()).unwrap(),b.programs.into_iter().map(|p|serde_json::from_str(&serde_json::to_string(&p.program).unwrap()).unwrap()).collect())
}
fn engine(source:&str)->Engine{let(s,p)=compile(source);Engine::new_release(Store::memory().unwrap(),s,p,1,None).unwrap()}
fn adopt(e:&mut Engine,source:&str,n:u64)->Result<u64,RuntimeError>{
    let(s,p)=compile(source);let previous=e.store().meta("release").unwrap().map(|s|s.parse().unwrap());
    e.adopt_release(s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(n,previous),false)
}

fn conditional_backfill_rollback_older_writes_and_forward_catchup(){

 adopt(&mut e,&ferry(),2).unwrap();

 let g=e.generation();adopt(&mut e,&ferry(),2).unwrap();assert_eq!(g,e.generation());
 write(&mut e,"classify");

 seed(&mut e,"bookings",json!({"id":"d","weight":3600,"length":1}));

}

 let next=old.replace("  n: int","  doubled: int\n  n: int").replace("  owner: principal","  score: int\n  owner: principal")+"backfill facts twice(n: int):\n  {doubled:n * 2}\nbackfill bookings scores(owner: principal):\n  {score:(facts[principal = owner] ! else NOT_FOUND).n}\n";
 let mut e=engine(old);seed(&mut e,"facts",json!({"id":"a","principal":"user:a","n":9}));seed(&mut e,"bookings",json!({"id":"b","owner":"user:a"}));
 adopt(&mut e,&narrow,2).unwrap();assert_eq!(e.store().count("facts").unwrap(),0);
 adopt(&mut e,&next,3).unwrap();assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"facts","a","doubled"),Value::Int(18));assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"bookings","b","score"),Value::Int(9));
}

#[test]
fn removal_of_last_opening_boundary_keeps_the_durable_retirement_floor() {
 let old="table items:\n  opens: time\n  until: time\n  n: int\n  not before .opens\n  expire at .until\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
 let next=old.replace("  not before .opens\n","").replace("  expire at .until\n","")+"backfill items prolong(until: time):\n  {until:until + 1d}\n";
 for requested in [1,100] {
  let(s,p)=compile(old);let mut e=Engine::new_release_prepared_at(Store::memory().unwrap(),s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(1,None),false,0).unwrap();
  let r=wire::row_from_json(&e.schema().tables["items"],&json!({"id":"a","opens":0,"until":50,"n":3})).unwrap();e.seed_at([("items".into(),r)],0).unwrap();
  {let tx=e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();tx.pin_time_audience_clock(100).unwrap();tx.commit().unwrap();}
  let(s,p)=compile(&next);e.adopt_release_at(s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(2,Some(1)),false,requested).unwrap();
  assert_eq!(e.store().count("items").unwrap(),0,"source deadline before persisted floor, requested={requested}");
 }
}

#[test]
fn reentry_restores_shared_snapshots_for_arguments_and_point_reads() {
 let old="table items:\n  n: int\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
 let twice=old.to_owned()+"backfill items twice(n: int):\n  {n:n * 2}\n";
 for later in [false,true] {
  let copied=twice.replace("  n: int","  copied: int\n  lookedUp: int\n  n: int")+"backfill items copy(n: int, id: items):\n  {copied:n, lookedUp:(items[id] ! else NOT_FOUND).n}\n";
  let mut e=engine(old);seed(&mut e,"items",json!({"id":"a","n":3}));
  if later {adopt(&mut e,&twice,2).unwrap();}
  adopt(&mut e,&copied,3).unwrap();let expected=if later {6}else{3};
  assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","a","copied"),Value::Int(expected));
  adopt(&mut e,"query empty():\n  return true\n",4).unwrap();adopt(&mut e,&copied,3).unwrap();
  assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","a","n"),Value::Int(6));assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","a","copied"),Value::Int(expected));assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","a","lookedUp"),Value::Int(expected));
 }
}

#[test]
fn leaving_the_last_backfill_cannot_remove_an_ended_source_lifetime() {
 let old="table items:\n  n: int\n  until: time\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
 let next=old.replace("  until: time","  until: time\n  expire at .until")+"backfill items twice(n: int):\n  {n:n * 2}\n";
 for absent in [false,true] {
  let(s,p)=compile(old);let mut e=Engine::new_release_prepared_at(Store::memory().unwrap(),s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(1,None),false,0).unwrap();
  let r=wire::row_from_json(&e.schema().tables["items"],&json!({"id":"a","n":3,"until":50})).unwrap();e.seed_at([("items".into(),r)],0).unwrap();
  let(s,p)=compile(&next);e.adopt_release_at(s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(2,Some(1)),false,1).unwrap();
  if absent {let(s,p)=compile("query empty():\n  return true\n");e.adopt_release_at(s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(3,Some(2)),false,2).unwrap();}
  let previous=if absent {3}else{2};let(s,p)=compile(old);e.adopt_release_at(s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(1,Some(previous)),false,100).unwrap();assert_eq!(e.store().count("items").unwrap(),0);
 }
}

#[test]
fn saved_reference_inputs_keep_their_own_lifetime_after_live_retargeting() {
 for kind in ["parents","id"] {
 let parents="table parents:\n  n: int\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
 let mutation="mutation retarget():\n  update children['c'] {parent:'q'}\n";
 let old=parents.to_owned()+"table children:\n  parent: parents on delete keep\n  public 'fixture'\n  update <- allow\n  online only\n"+mutation;
 let fill=format!("backfill children copy(parent: {kind}):\n  {{copied:(parents[parent] ! else NOT_FOUND).n}}\n");
 let next=old.replace("  parent: parents","  copied: int\n  parent: parents")+&fill;
 let dropped=next.replace("  parent: parents on delete keep\n","").replace(mutation,"");
 let mut e=engine(&old);for(id,n)in[("p",3),("q",9)]{seed(&mut e,"parents",json!({"id":id,"n":n}));}seed(&mut e,"children",json!({"id":"c","parent":"p"}));adopt(&mut e,&next,2).unwrap();write(&mut e,"retarget");adopt(&mut e,&dropped,3).unwrap();
 let table=e.schema().tables["parents"].clone();{let tx=e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();let r=tx.get("parents","p").unwrap().unwrap();tx.delete("parents",&table,&r).unwrap();tx.commit().unwrap();}seed(&mut e,"parents",json!({"id":"p","n":77}));
 adopt(&mut e,parents,4).unwrap();let error=adopt(&mut e,&dropped,3).unwrap_err().to_string();assert!(error.contains("parent lifetime"),"{error}");
}
}

#[test]
fn backfill_source_expiry_applies_cascade_set_null_and_restrict_atomically() {
 for action in ["cascade","set null","restrict"] {for restored in [false,true] {
  let optional=if action=="set null" {" ?"}else{""};
  let old=format!("table parents:\n  until: time\n  expire at .until\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\ntable children:\n  parent: parents{optional} on delete {action}\n  cap 4 by parent\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\ntable items:\n  n: int\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n");
  let next=old.replace("table items:\n  n:","table items:\n  doubled: int\n  n:")+"backfill items twice(n: int):\n  {doubled:n * 2}\n";
  let(s,p)=compile(&old);let mut e=Engine::new_release_prepared_at(Store::memory().unwrap(),s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(1,None),false,0).unwrap();
  let rows=[("parents",json!({"id":"p","until":50})),("children",json!({"id":"c","parent":"p"})),("items",json!({"id":"i","n":3}))];
  let rows=rows.into_iter().map(|(t,r)|(t.to_owned(),wire::row_from_json(&e.schema().tables[t],&r).unwrap())).collect::<Vec<_>>();e.seed_at(rows,0).unwrap();
  if restored {let(s,p)=compile("table items:\n  n: int\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n");e.adopt_release_at(s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(2,Some(1)),false,1).unwrap();}
  let g=e.generation();let(s,p)=compile(&next);let result=e.adopt_release_at(s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(3,Some(if restored {2}else{1})),false,100);
  if action=="restrict" {let error=result.unwrap_err().to_string();assert!(error.contains("source expiry")&&error.contains("restrict"),"{error}");assert_eq!(g,e.generation());assert!(row(&mut e,"items","i").field("doubled").is_err());}
  else {result.unwrap();assert_eq!(e.store().count("parents").unwrap(),0);if action=="cascade" {assert_eq!(e.store().count("children").unwrap(),0);}else{assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"children","c","parent"),Value::Null);}assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","i","doubled"),Value::Int(6));}
 }}
}
#[test]
fn reset_rebuilds_retained_schema_metadata_before_native_inserts_or_reseeding() {
 for reseed in [false,true] {
  let old="table items:\n  n: int\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
  let next=old.replace("  n: int","  derived: int\n  n: int")+"backfill items twice(n: int):\n  {derived:n * 2}\n";
  let mut e=engine(old);adopt(&mut e,&next,2).unwrap();
  let native=wire::row_from_json(&e.schema().tables["items"],&json!({"id":"native","n":3,"derived":9})).unwrap();
  e.dev_reset_at(if reseed {vec![("items".into(),native)]}else{vec![]},crate::now_ms()).unwrap();
  if !reseed {seed(&mut e,"items",json!({"id":"native","n":3,"derived":9}));}
  adopt(&mut e,old,1).unwrap();adopt(&mut e,&next,2).unwrap();assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","native","derived"),Value::Int(9));
 }
}

#[test]
fn enum_replacement_accepts_original_preimages_and_preserves_native_outputs() {
 let old="table cues:\n  status: enum('standby','done')\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
 let second=old.replace("enum('standby','done')","enum('standby','complete','skipped')")+"backfill cues complete(status: enum('standby','done')):\n  {status:'complete' if status = 'done' else status}\n";
 let third=old.replace("enum('standby','done')","enum('standby','finished','skipped')")+"backfill cues finished(status: enum('standby','done','complete','skipped')):\n  {status:'finished' if status = 'done' or status = 'complete' else status}\n";
 let mut e=engine(old);seed(&mut e,"cues",json!({"id":"a","status":"done"}));adopt(&mut e,&second,2).unwrap();seed(&mut e,"cues",json!({"id":"native","status":"complete"}));
 adopt(&mut e,&third,3).unwrap();for id in ["a","native"]{assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"cues",id,"status"),Value::String("finished".into()));}
 adopt(&mut e,&second,2).unwrap();for id in ["a","native"]{assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"cues",id,"status"),Value::String("complete".into()));}
}

#[test]
fn retained_hidden_optional_inputs_are_used_when_reentering_a_backfill() {
 let old="table items:\n  n: int ?\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
 let next="table items:\n  derived: int\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\nbackfill items twice(n: int ?):\n  {derived:(n ?? 0) * 2}\n";
 let bridge="table items:\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
 let mut e=engine(old);seed(&mut e,"items",json!({"id":"a","n":3}));adopt(&mut e,next,2).unwrap();assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","a","derived"),Value::Int(6));
 adopt(&mut e,old,1).unwrap();adopt(&mut e,bridge,3).unwrap();adopt(&mut e,next,2).unwrap();assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","a","derived"),Value::Int(6));
}
#[test]
fn source_expiry_observes_children_removed_in_the_same_release() {
 for action in ["cascade","set null","restrict"] {
  let optional=if action=="set null" {" ?"}else{""};
  let parent="table parents:\n  until: time\n  expire at .until\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
  let child=format!("table children:\n  parent: parents{optional} on delete {action}\n  cap 4 by parent\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n");
  let item="table items:\n  n: int\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
  let old=format!("{parent}{child}{item}");let next=format!("{parent}{}backfill items twice(n: int):\n  {{doubled:n * 2}}\n",item.replace("  n:","  doubled: int\n  n:"));
  let(s,p)=compile(&old);let mut e=Engine::new_release_prepared_at(Store::memory().unwrap(),s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(1,None),false,0).unwrap();
  let rows=[("parents",json!({"id":"p","until":50})),("children",json!({"id":"c","parent":"p"})),("items",json!({"id":"i","n":3}))];
  let rows=rows.into_iter().map(|(t,r)|(t.to_owned(),wire::row_from_json(&e.schema().tables[t],&r).unwrap())).collect::<Vec<_>>();e.seed_at(rows,0).unwrap();
  let(s,p)=compile(&next);let result=e.adopt_release_at(s,p,&ReleaseActivation::new(2,Some(1)),false,100);
  if action=="restrict" {let error=result.unwrap_err().to_string();assert!(error.contains("restrict"),"{error}");assert_eq!(e.store().count("parents").unwrap(),1);}else{
   result.unwrap();assert_eq!(e.store().count("parents").unwrap(),0);
   let tx=e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();let t=tx.num("children").unwrap();
   let saved:Option<String>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data FROM _dormant_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id='c'",[t],|r|r.get(0)).optional().unwrap();
   if action=="cascade" {assert!(saved.is_none());}else{let saved:Value=serde_json::from_str(&saved.unwrap()).unwrap();assert_eq!(*saved.field("parent").unwrap(),Value::Null);}
  }
 }
}

#[test]
fn physically_sparse_defaults_are_interpreted_and_receipts_keep_that_interpretation() {
 for kind in ["int","int ?"] {
  let old="table items:\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\n";
  let defaulted=old.replace("  public","  n: int default 3\n  public");
  let fill=format!("backfill items twice(n: {kind}):\n  {{doubled:(n ?? 0) * 2}}\n");
  let next=defaulted.replace("  n:","  doubled: int\n  n:")+&fill;
  let mut e=engine(old);seed(&mut e,"items",json!({"id":"a"}));adopt(&mut e,&defaulted,2).unwrap();
  assert!(row(&mut e,"items","a").field("n").is_err(),"fixture is physically sparse");
  adopt(&mut e,&next,3).unwrap();assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","a","doubled"),Value::Int(6));
  let later=next.replace("default 3","default 100");adopt(&mut e,&later,4).unwrap();adopt(&mut e,"query empty():\n  return true\n",5).unwrap();adopt(&mut e,&later,4).unwrap();
  assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","a","doubled"),Value::Int(6));
  let rollback=later.replace("  doubled: int\n","").replace(&fill,"");adopt(&mut e,&rollback,6).unwrap();adopt(&mut e,&later,4).unwrap();
  assert_eq!(field(&mut e,"items","a","doubled"),Value::Int(6),"rollback/forward keeps the original omitted-input interpretation");
 }
}
